I was looking after a little girl, i.e. babysitting, although the father was still there, I put her to bed a few nights in a row, and neither she nor the father nor the house looked familiar to me; and in the course of this I got an email from the BAfög office and also a new car. In the end, I always went over to their place in the evening, put the little girl to bed and then went home again. It was kind of a fancy neighborhood. The main people there were the daughter, the father and me.
